decisions.statement: A color is named rather than specified.
Whatever draws the color picks the shade from its own palette.
Each hex here is a shade the palette draws.
A hex here has a plain name rather than the source's name.
The neutrals run from soot up to chalk.
Grey sits between stone and silver.
A color stating no hex is drawn in whatever text color the reader already has.

definition: one color anything can be drawn in
